SELECT company_id,
            MAX(CASE WHEN starts_at <= ? THEN starts_at END) AS last_at,
            MIN(CASE WHEN starts_at > ? THEN starts_at END) AS next_at
       FROM meetings WHERE link_status IN ('auto', 'manual') AND company_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) GROUP BY company_id

SELECT company_id, title, starts_at FROM (
       SELECT company_id, title, starts_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_id ORDER BY starts_at) AS rn
         FROM meetings WHERE link_status IN ('auto', 'manual') AND starts_at > ? AND company_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
     ) WHERE rn = 1
SELECT company_id, MAX(last_contacted_at) AS last_at FROM contacts WHERE company_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) GROUP BY company_id
